weaknesses.detail: match requires FILEGID+EGID and GROUPNAME+GROUP dual; agents often check only one and admit wrong.

weaknesses.title: GROUPS bag format / primary-first order undocumented for agents
weaknesses.detail: Only root on this host; multi-group hosts may differ primary placement. No GROUPS_IDS numeric bag dual.

weaknesses.title: HAS vs HASLINE false friends on group allowlists
weaknesses.detail: HAS allow ops matches ops_admin substring risk; HASLINE exact is correct but easy to mix.

weaknesses.title: Comma roster needs REPLACEALL \\n dance — no CSV bag form

weaknesses.title: GID vs EGID rarely differ but no setgid/clear_groups story
weaknesses.detail: Agents assume always equal; no documentation when they diverge after setgid helpers.

weaknesses.title: WRITE metas omit trailing NL
